question: Choose the word that is the antonym of **Incredible**.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Ordinary**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Incredible"** means something that is so extraordinary or amazing that it is difficult to believe. (अविश्वसनीय)
 
 
• **Example:** The view from the top of the mountain was so incredible that it took my breath away.
 
 
• The word **"Ordinary"** refers to something that is normal, usual, or not special in any way. It is the opposite of incredible. (साधारण)
 
 
• **Example:** She wore an ordinary dress to the event, nothing too fancy or extraordinary.
